examples.impact: Connects behavior, evidence and its limit
examples.quote: On Totoro, final optimized R source passed both new prior test files and the 10-file affected regression set (9.099 seconds; two existing live-Julia comparison skips). Julia final source passed its 82-check focused suite and 14 affected test files. Five live R-to-Julia fixtures passed, including same-name mu/sigma predictors, binomial partial priors, zero ridge, factor interaction and no-intercept factors. Maximum coefficient gap was 4.30e-11; maximum data-log-likelihood gap was 1.07e-12. This is bounded fixture agreement, not general parity or interval calibration.
